descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · S17 「同一天重扫同一张护士长名单：什么都不会建两次」 Same-day re-scan of the same supervisor list: nothing is created twice

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U3 The photo uses the same deduplication against All Residents as TC-02. Before anything is written, the physician sees how many residents are already known and how many are new (e.g. …（UAT TC-09；UAT TC-02 (by reference)；TFA-92587 AC 3）
  • U2 Photographing the nursing supervisor's list adds the residents on it to Today's Visits. Residents already in All Residents go onto today's list, and new ones are created.（UAT TC-09；TFA-92587 AC 3；TFA-92587 How it works 3）

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given QA Alder and QA Birch seeded as in S04; in this run the agent first scans supervisor-day1.jpg and confirms, as in S04

When Scan supervisor-day1.jpg again the same day (the physician retakes a better photo) → read the sheet → confirm → Today's Visits → All Residents

Then The second sheet says all 4 residents are already known and none is new. After confirming, each of the four exists once in All Residents and is on Today's Visits

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs: s17-rescan-sheet has '4 residents found', '4 already' and '0 new' (U3, no count runner needed); s17-today has all four and mustNotContain 'In Today ✓'; s17-all has all four and 'In Today ✓'. Each name exactly once is a backend read of snf:list (U3 'never duplicating')

在哪跑：dev 单元 U81；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S17 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-09.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：API · 接口（Convex 函数） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
